name: feedback
title: Feedback
description: The response to the player's last act: correct, wrong, score or reward. A wrong answer shakes, a score increment floats up and fades, and the message itself changes colour, glyph and text so it survives reduced motion, mute and colour blindness alike. Renders synchronously with its props, because the gap between a tap and this element appearing is the library's 100ms budget. Performs nothing: it does not decide whether the last act was right, does not know the running score, and does not settle a reward.
docs: Pass `variant` to say which of the four contract outcomes this is. Pass `message` for the host's own copy (the reason an answer was wrong, a reward's name); leave it out and a default word for the variant renders instead. Pass `delta` on a `score` variant for the signed amount that floats up, e.g. 50 or -10. Mount it fresh per settlement (a changing `key` works well) rather than toggling it, since the shake and the float are entrance animations that play once, on mount.
